characters.description: Port Atwood's leader and a cultivator who can alternate between living and Draugr forms. He begins the book testing powerful undead skills during his Tower climb while trying to keep the dangerous Oblivion splinter under control.
characters.name: Zac

characters.description: Zac's demon partner. He helps establish that the taunting effect of an undead skill can initially disrupt a capable fighter, though repeated exposure allows resistance.
characters.name: Ogras

characters.description: Zac's axe tool spirit. It reacts with distress to the death attunement around one of his undead skills but is not harmed.
characters.name: Verun

characters.description: An aged demon pugilist who serves as both the floor guardian and Zac's apparent teacher. He exposes weaknesses in Zac's unarmed fighting and urges him to rely more fully on instinct.
characters.name: Erudite Master

characters.description: A traveling Ent who accompanies Zac and tells him that access to the Pool of Tranquility requires victory over the Enlightened Three.
characters.name: Ent traveler

characters.description: The leader of the dryad clan hosting the Dao Discourse. She presides over the contest and decides who may enter the Pool of Tranquility.
characters.name: Dryad matriarch

characters.description: Three dryad siblings who guard access to the Pool of Tranquility through the Dao Discourse. They are the matriarch's grandchildren and have remained at peak F-grade to deepen their souls and Dao insight.
characters.name: Enlightened Three

characters.description: An ant-like woodland being who discreetly alerts Zac to danger in the Pool of Tranquility. Speaking up could damage his family's standing with the dryads.
characters.name: Thelem

characters.description: A demon ally whose dangerous poison constitution and uncertain treatment remain concerns while Zac is away in the Tower.
characters.name: Alea

characters.description: A rapidly advancing Port Atwood war leader. Her position on the ladders suggests that she and Billy have recently survived a major battle while Zac remains in the Tower.
characters.name: Thea Marshall

characters.description: A powerful human fighter whose sudden rise in level and Dao standing suggests that he and Thea have faced an unusually strong opponent.
characters.name: Billy

characters.description: A woman outside the Tower who monitors Zac's climb and investigates his unexplained connection to her ancestor.
characters.name: External observer

characters.description: A representative of the Zethaya Pill House. He confirms that Rasuliel Tsarun provoked the earlier dispute over the Pathfinder Oracle's eye and seeks a way to restore business relations with Zac.
characters.name: Boje Zethaya

characters.description: A nobleman caught in a lethal succession struggle. He organizes an ambush for Zac's emergence from the Tower, hoping the expected quest reward will secure his survival.
characters.name: Rival nobleman

characters.description: The creature living in Ogras's shadows. Ogras uses Leech as part of an array-assisted fighting method during his separate Tower climb.
characters.name: Leech

characters.description: An overwhelmingly strong contestant in the Battle of Fates. Her devastating flame domain and powerful bloodline avatar make nearby cultivators avoid confronting her.
characters.name: Flame cultivator

characters.description: A Battle of Fates contestant who traps Zac in a soul attack that nearly destroys him. The released Oblivion splinter turns the attack back and leaves the mentalist dying before a masked assassin finishes the job.
characters.name: Mentalist

characters.description: The leaderboard identity of the masked contestant who attacked Zac with a black spike after a mentalist nearly destroyed his soul.
characters.name: Faceless Number Nine

characters.description: Zac's sister and a member of Port Atwood. During his Tower climb, Zac confirms that she remains alive.
characters.name: Kenzie

characters.description: An Undead Empire commander coordinating an alignment, spatial locks around Zac's island kingdom, and the recovery of a valuable body for a powerful patron's disciple.
characters.name: Undead commander

characters.description: A blind elder and apparent senior figure of a prophetic clan. He confronts Zac over a prediction concerning his family's survival and triggers a sinkhole that traps them underground.
characters.name: Blind clan elder

characters.description: A noncombat crew member aboard the Technocrat vessel Little Bean. Captured by Zac, he becomes a source of information about the stranded ship and its anomalous cargo.
characters.name: Communications officer

characters.description: The class-three transhuman captain and part owner of the Little Bean. His strength makes open combat aboard the vessel extremely dangerous for Zac.
characters.name: Little Bean captain

characters.description: Zac and Kenzie's missing mother. A necklace connected to her grants Zac exceptional authority aboard a Technocrat vessel, raising new questions about her identity and history.
characters.name: Leandra

characters.description: A late-class-two Technocrat specialist who maintains the creation shard's containment field. His special authorization makes him central to Zac's attempt to reach the restricted cargo.
characters.name: Containment researcher

characters.description: A merchant and Tower acquaintance who emerges beside Ogras into the hostile crowd waiting at the Tower exit.
characters.name: Galau

characters.description: The young Dravarak prince identified as the leader of the coordinated Tower-exit attack after Zac kills him.
characters.name: Dravarak prince

characters.description: A cultivator from the Empire Heartlands who believes Zac may be linked to her missing ancestor. She arrives with undead attendants, presents evidence of an outside bounty, and requests a private exchange.
characters.name: Draugr visitor

characters.description: A winged Everlasting Dao bishop who directs a large fire array against Zac during the siege of Port Atwood.
characters.name: Cultist bishop

characters.description: A chained coffin spirit tool created from Alea's transformation. After Zac binds it, Love's Bond can form a shield or release durable, corrosive chains, but Alea gives no detectable response.
characters.name: Love's Bond

characters.description: A spirit-tool expert who examines Love's Bond. Brasla explains that its false spirit may mature and that restoring Alea to a living body could be possible, though the path is uncertain and may require unconventional methods.
characters.name: Brasla

characters.description: Within Zac's uncertain heart-tribulation vision, Robert appears to oppose Leandra's decision to abandon the children.
characters.name: Robert

characters.description: A disguised peak D-grade cultivator who manipulates fate. After buying intelligence about Zac, he plans to find Zac's seed world, kill him, and exploit his connection to the world's fate for an ascension array.
characters.name: Fate manipulator

characters.description: A synthetic advisor stored in Leandra's pendant and modeled on Leandra. It offers an account of why Leandra disappeared, while warning Zac to conceal their family connection.
characters.name: Leandra pendant AI

characters.description: A Port Atwood combatant who insists on joining Zac's operation against the Dead Zone despite his initial reluctance.
characters.name: Emily

characters.description: The Valkyrie commander assigned to lead a six-member defensive squad protecting Kenzie and Emily during the Dead Zone mission.
characters.name: Joanna

characters.description: The leader behind the undead forces conducting the realignment effort against Earth. His command remains elsewhere when Zac clears the diversionary force at Arjrodim.
characters.name: Lich King

characters.description: One of the Lich King's apparent generals at the undead fortress.
characters.name: Female undead general

characters.description: A concealed undead general who ambushes Zac in the Lich King's underground chamber and wounds him through the lung.
characters.name: Spectral assassin

characters.description: A powerful lizard-like Everlasting Dao leader commanding the vessel that attacks the ruined undead fortress. His white fire is strong enough to contest Zac's assault.
characters.name: Everlasting Dao leader

characters.description: The Lich King's noncombat attendant and former household caretaker. Bound by directives that punish classified disclosures, he can still explain general features of the nexus and the Seed of Undeath.
characters.name: Ghost custodian

characters.description: A continuing enemy from an earlier stage of the conflict who remains a threat to Zac and Earth.
characters.name: Great Redeemer
